Financial figures are from the FY2024 Form 10-K (accession 0000884887-25-000050), checked against SEC XBRL; ownership is from the 2025 proxy (DEF 14A filed April 18, 2025, accession 0000884887-25-000087), as of April 1, 2025. LEADER, JUDGMENT CALL ON RELATION: Lisa Lutoff-Perlo was a named executive officer for 2020 to 2023 but not for 2024 (pay-versus-performance footnote), and she is not in the 2025 proxy's directors-and-executive-officers ownership table, so status is no-reported-stake with values null. The schema has no value for the CEO of a subsidiary brand (Celebrity Cruises); 'former-ceo' is used and should be read as former brand CEO, not former CEO of Royal Caribbean Group. HOLDERS: the three largest 5% holders are listed; the proxy gives 13G/A filing dates (Capital Research Global Investors February 13, 2025; Vanguard July 10, 2024; AWILHELMSEN AS February 12, 2025, plus a Form 4 of November 21, 2024), not the dates the holdings refer to, so asOf is null. Director Arne Alexander Wilhelmsen's 18,174,326 shares (6.69%) include the 18,167,507 AWILHELMSEN AS shares (he disclaims beneficial ownership of them), so he is not listed separately. No Pritzker entity appears in the 2025 proxy's 5% table, so none is recorded. BlackRock (6.0%) and Capital World Investors (5.1%) are the other 5% holders. DIVIDENDS: cash paid was $107 million; dividends declared in 2024 were $255 million ($0.95 per share, equity statement); the cash-paid figure is used. BUYBACKS: none; the equity statement shows $12 million of treasury stock purchases, not described as repurchases (the 10-K says there were no repurchases of common stock in 2024). GEOGRAPHY: the company's table is by cruise itinerary region, not customer location; 'North America' includes the United States, Canada, Mexico and the Caribbean. 'Other revenues' ($788 million: cancellation fees, insurance, tours, port fees, services to affiliates) is not assigned to a region and is shown as its own row. Separately, the 10-K says 75% of 2024 passenger ticket revenues came from guests sourced in the United States.
